videos.script: On Thursday at nine in the morning, ana had an escalation, a priority of one, and a question nobody had answered in advance. {{question}} Who decides whether the file server is taken offline? If that question is asked for the first time during an incident, it is answered badly, by whoever is loudest. {{loud}} Preparation is answering it on a quiet Tuesday. Who does what, who may decide what, who to call, and how to call them when the usual channels may be watched. {{prepare}} This lesson is the first of five on incident response, one per phase. {{five}} It ends with the cheapest way to find out a plan does not work: rehearsing it around a table. {{tabletop}}
